source_evidence: Exact player 'And you? Will you remain here? Or is there somewhere more important to go to? someone?' asks Caul's own intentions and whether she has higher priority destinations/people. Caul says she intends to remain at her manor for now, maintain household and carry out promised voluntary reform trial to demonstrate worth rather than accompany V; would welcome invitation to recovered ancestral seat when found. No current House steward appointment, departure or travel chosen. In response to question about someone important she voluntarily identifies two actual autonomous immortal allies by existing titles, Pale Chancellor (scholar/jurist, custodian of selected older legal and occult records) and Amber Exarch (ancient priest-ruler, holds interest in old sacred rights and hereditary treaties). Explains they became associated with remnants of Silver Court after Convergence; they are neither her masters nor necessarily former sworn servants of V's father. She considers Chancellor a possible relevant source for further inheritance records, no guaranteed information, access, locations or itinerary. She states they do not yet know of V's return and prefers not to announce it prematurely because both have ambitions and an interest in his recognition. No report dispatched, binding confidentiality promise, peer allegiance, verified personal names, disclosed secret faction title, specific monstrous nature, hidden sites, occult plan, new quest acceptance or obligation to visit. V chooses whether to question further or act on existing leads. D334~20:33. Existing signed tower handover, captive release order en route and conditional pilot unchanged; no implementation result, spending, rest, combat or resource change.
